reproduction.source: the 2026-09-12 efficiency/review incident in this checkout

observed_review_attempts.rerun_policy: both independent reviewers reran after each packet change

root_causes: independent reviewers were on the same sequential critical path
a blocking first-eyes result caused a new packet and both reviewers were rerun
review input was repeatedly expanded instead of reusing unchanged reviewer evidence
failed/partial/defer artifacts were not first-class reusable carriers
quality duration was paid after review churn rather than as an explicitly bounded stage
the first dogfood draft manufactured review status and rerun evidence instead of invoking the carrier lifecycle
a ThreadPoolExecutor context-manager shutdown could extend a reviewer timeout after the deadline
partial-result bytes and post-recovery lifecycle bytes lacked complete immutable joins
timeout carriers claimed retention and resume without an observed attempt join
targeted rerun selection was counted as execution without a third receipt
the shared dispatcher had ordering but no fail-closed prerequisite gate
final lifecycle promotion could reject its own durable partial-receipt enrichment as stale
result-ready reviewer children were not proven terminated before collection
release-stage results had no durable run receipt or intent binding

integration_fixture.review_execution: installed plugin run_review.py with file-backed worker
integration_fixture.timeout_reconciliation: real installed reviewer inside the timed-out callback, retained same-attempt recovery, process-group cleanup, bounded probes, and terminal readback
integration_fixture.targeted_rerun: installed plugin run_review.py against the changed follow-up packet
integration_fixture.stage_gate_negative_control: shared dispatcher blocks publish after blocked/deferred/failed/unproven or contradictory-open prerequisites
negative_controls: replace partial-result and update its manifest descriptor while leaving backend.stdout unchanged
change one reviewer packet identity and derive only that reviewer as rerunnable
substitute a readable terminal carrier from another attempt and require reconciliation to remain pending
substitute a readable non-terminal carrier for the expected attempt and require reconciliation to remain pending
launch a non-returning reviewer descendant and require the owned process group to terminate it
make artifact discovery never return and require initial/reconciliation probes to remain bounded
run a command worker under spawn and fail a non-serializable callback closed as blocked-unproven
return a reviewer result while its child remains alive and require bounded shutdown
read and resume a release-run receipt from a fresh process without replaying completed stages
reject a conflicting packet for the same intent at both resume and new-run creation
reject foreign stage/attempt/key/run/readback identities during crash recovery
serialize two concurrent resume processes so one executes and one reads back complete
reject a sequential second receipt path for the same intent, scope, and packet
serialize concurrent receipt creation so one canonical owner executes and the loser has no stage effect
block a terminal closed stage until an adapter readback proves its effect state
reject durable creation without a resume command
keep requested and observed bindings separate for foreign receipt contention
retain stage attempt and readback history when an authorized retry fails
